DNA-methylation_preprocessing

library(glue)
library(ENmix)
library(minfiData)

project_dir <- "~/Documents/repos/explant-seq"
DNAm_dir <- glue("{project_dir}/data/DNA/DNA-methylation/2026-06-19")

# if the following line errors out with Basename empty, it is because excel converted the array name to a number with scientific notation
# fix in excel and rerun
sheet <- read.metharray.sheet(glue("{DNAm_dir}/rawdata"), pattern = "csv$")
## [read.metharray.sheet] Found the following CSV files:
## [1] "/Users/petra/Documents/repos/explant-seq/data/DNA/DNA-methylation/2026-06-19/rawdata/260619_DNAm_sample_sheet.csv"
## Warning in readLines(file): incomplete final line found on
## '/Users/petra/Documents/repos/explant-seq/data/DNA/DNA-methylation/2026-06-19/rawdata/260619_DNAm_sample_sheet.csv'
rgSet <- read.metharray.exp(targets = sheet, extended = TRUE)
qc <- QCinfo(rgSet, distplot = TRUE)
## 0  samples with percentage of low quality CpG value greater than  0.05  or bisulfite intensity less than  10737.09 
## 40026  CpGs with percentage of low quality value greater than  0.05 
## Ploting qc_sample.jpg ...
## Done
## Ploting qc_CpG.jpg ...
## Done
## Identifying ourlier samples based on beta or total intensity values...
## After excluding low quality samples and CpGs
## 0  samples are outliers based on averaged total intensity value 
## 0  samples are outliers in beta value distribution 
## 0  outlier samples were added into badsample list
## Ploting freqpolygon_beta_beforeQC.jpg ...
## Done
## Ploting freqpolygon_beta_afterQC.jpg ...
## Done
plotCtrl(rgSet)
## Plotting  STAINING .jpg
## Plotting  EXTENSION .jpg
## Plotting  HYBRIDIZATION .jpg
## Plotting  TARGET_REMOVAL .jpg
## Plotting  BISULFITE_CONVERSION_I .jpg
## Plotting  BISULFITE_CONVERSION_II .jpg
## Plotting  SPECIFICITY_I .jpg
## Plotting  SPECIFICITY_II .jpg
## Plotting  NON-POLYMORPHIC .jpg
## Plotting  NEGATIVE .jpg
## Plotting  NORM_A .jpg
## Plotting  NORM_C .jpg
## Plotting  NORM_G .jpg
## Plotting  NORM_T .jpg
## Plotting  NORM_ACGT .jpg
mdat <- preprocessENmix(
  rgSet,
  bg = "oob",
  dye = "RELIC",
  QCinfo = qc,
  exQCsample = TRUE,
  exQCcpg = TRUE,
  nCores = 4
)
## 40026  CpGs were excluded before ENmix correction
## Analysis is running, please wait...!
beta <- getB(mdat, type = "Illumina", offset = 100)
multifreqpoly(beta, main = "Beta value distributions")

library(ggplot2)
library(magrittr)

# Check sex prediction
gmSet <- mapToGenome(mdat)
sex_pred <- getSex(gmSet)
## Warning in .getSex(CN = CN, xIndex = xIndex, yIndex = yIndex, cutoff = cutoff): An inconsistency was encountered while determining sex. One possibility is that
## only one sex is present. We recommend further checks, for example with the plotSex function.
sex_pred$predictedSex
## 209484350181_R01C01 209484350181_R02C01 209484350181_R03C01 209484350181_R04C01 209484350181_R05C01 209484350181_R06C01 209484350181_R07C01 209484350181_R08C01 
##                 "M"                 "M"                 "M"                 "M"                 "M"                 "M"                 "M"                 "M" 
## 209535170048_R01C01 209535170048_R02C01 209535170048_R03C01 209535170048_R04C01 209535170048_R05C01 209535170048_R06C01 209535170048_R07C01 209535170048_R08C01 
##                 "M"                 "M"                 "M"                 "M"                 "M"                 "M"                 "M"                 "M"
sheet$Array_slide <- paste0(sheet$Slide, "_", sheet$Array)
sex_df <- as.data.frame(sex_pred)
sex_df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(sex_df, var = "Array_slide")
sex_df <- sex_df %>% dplyr::left_join(sheet %>% dplyr::select(Sample_Name, Array_slide, Sex), by="Array_slide")

ggplot(sex_df, aes(x = xMed, y = yMed, color = Sex)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    x = "Median X chr intensity (log2)",
    y = "Median Y chr intensity (log2)",
    title = "Predicted sex: X vs Y chromosome intensity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

Deconvolution

library(HiBED)
data("HiBED_Libraries")

Mset_raw <- preprocessRaw(rgSet)
betas_for_deconv <- getBeta(Mset_raw)
# strip EPICv2 suffixes back to standard cg IDs before matching
rownames(betas_for_deconv) <- sub("_.*", "", rownames(betas_for_deconv))

HiBED_result <- HiBED_deconvolution(betas_for_deconv, h = 2)
HiBED_result <- tibble::rownames_to_column(HiBED_result, var = "Array_slide")
HiBED_result <- sheet %>% 
  dplyr::select(Array_slide, Sample_Name, Contact_anatomy) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(HiBED_result, by="Array_slide")

head(HiBED_result)

## 6 209484350181_R06C01     EXP009_RIA_8                WM    3.678875 2.551125 0.2418832   80.06335       1.1147662 0.05833333 0.22166667
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(paletteer)

df_long <- HiBED_result %>%
  mutate(
    subject   = sub("_.*", "", Sample_Name),
    electrode = sub("^[^_]+_([A-Za-z]+)_.*", "\\1", Sample_Name),
    # combine sample name + anatomy into one label, used directly as the x factor
    contact_label = paste(Sample_Name, Contact_anatomy, sep = "\n"),
    contact_label = factor(contact_label, levels = unique(contact_label))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Astrocyte, Oligodendrocyte, GABA, GLU),
    names_to = "CellType", values_to = "Proportion"
  )


ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Contact_anatomy, y = Proportion, fill = CellType)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") + 
  facet_wrap(~ paste(subject, electrode), scales = "free_x", nrow = 2) +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = "Cell type proportion (% of tissue)",
    fill = "Cell type",
    title = "Cell type composition by electrode contact",
    subtitle = "Microglia, endothelial cells and stromal cells were removed"
  ) + 
  scale_fill_paletteer_d("rcartocolor::Bold") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
